find: After Watergate, Congress seized former President Nixon's papers and tapes for archival screening
replace: After Watergate, Congress directed the Administrator of General Services to take custody of former President Nixon's presidential papers and tapes for screening by executive-branch archivists
reason: The Act assigned custody and screening to the Executive Branch. That allocation was central to the separation-of-powers holding.
